title: Resource Pack Sync
description: Automatically syncs your Minecraft resource pack folder with supported global loaders like Paxi. All your fav packs in one place!
body:
# Resource Pack Sync

Automatically syncs your Minecraft resource pack folder with supported global loaders like Paxi.
Just download your packs into one folder and enjoy.

## Features

- Automatic resource pack syncing
- Paxi integration
- Blacklist support (Removed in 1.1.0 version for now)
- Lightweight and modular
- Client-side only
- Supports zip and folder packs

## Credits

Made by Starcage.
Special thanks to YUNGNICKYOUNG for creating Paxi, which inspired and powers the global resource pack loading used by this mod.
